card.title: Make It Official
card.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you Keeper of the Festival Lantern.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said I'd hold it while you tied your shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An excellent probationary performance. Here's your badge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until you find a qualified successor. The lantern must never be abandoned.

mechanism: A turns temporary lantern holding into an official custodial appointment whose exit requires succession.
confusable: Unlike requesting continued help plainly, A must make a title and ceremony feel binding.
comparison: A badge and qualified successor extend a fleeting favor; the patron scene formalizes continued applause for donors.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
